T.O.P. RC RACEWAY
RULES
1. RACEWAY IS OPEN DURNG PARK OPERATION HOURS OF 8AM TO 10:00PM
2. ONLY BATTERY OPERATED RC CARS PERMITTED. NO NITRO OR GAS POWERED
VEHICLES, BICYCLES, MINI-BIKES ALLOWED.
3. NO RUNNING on racetrack
4. NO dogs on race track. Dogs MUST be leashed at all times and discouraged at track.
5. ENTER TRACK SAFELY WHEN ALL RC RACE CARS HAVE STOPPED
6. DO NOT MODIFY THE RACETRACK
7. NO PARKING ON THE GRASS. USE GRAVEL LOT PLEASE
8. ALL VEHICLES MUST FOLLOW THE INTENDED TRACK DIRECTION
9. DO NOT USE TRACK IN BAD WEATHER TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO TRACK
10. EVERYONE MARSHALLS: If you are using the track, you must take turns marshalling.
Marshalling is spending time on the track to flip cars over and place back on rack. You must be
over the age of 12 to Marshall or with an adult.
11. GOOD SPORTSMANSHIP IS THE MOST IMPORTANT RULE. The racetrack is family
friendly. Please live by example for all age groups enjoying the racetrack.
12. FOLLOW ALL TOWN OF PERINTON PARK CODES, CHAPTER 159
13. HAVE A GREAT TIME WITH YOUR FRIENDS AND FAMILY
At Park Operations
50 Cobbs Lane
